info.name: Parking Slot Management API
info.description:
Walks the parking workflow: slots, requests and the queue, allocation rules (one slot per employee and per vehicle), rejection reasons, cancelling, releasing and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8106). Repeatable: it registers fresh employees and creates uniquely coded slots on floor 7 each run.

exec: const letters = () => String.fromCharCode(65 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 26)) + String.fromCharCode(65 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 26));

item.name: Register a fresh employee for this run
Login as an employee who already has a slot
Employee sees the free slots on that floor

exec: pm.test("Both new slots, no occupant names", () => { const l = pm.response.json().filter(s => s.code.startsWith(pm.collectionVariables.get("slotPrefix"))); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(l[0].occupantName).to.eql(null); });

item.name: Request a slot (spaces around the number are ignored)
A second pending request is a conflict
Someone who already holds a slot cannot ask

exec: pm.test("Found with the employee's name", () => { const r = pm.response.json().find(x => x.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("requestId")); pm.expect(r.employeeName).to.eql("Postman Employee"); });

item.name: Approve without a slot is rejected
A reserved slot cannot be allocated

exec: pm.test("Approved with the slot", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("APPROVED"); pm.expect(r.slotCode).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("slotCode")); pm.expect(r.decidedBy).to.eql("parkadmin"); });

item.name: Rejecting a decided request is a conflict

exec: pm.test("Slot and vehicle", () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.slotCode).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("slotCode")); pm.expect(a.vehicleNumber).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("vehicleA")); pm.expect(a.active).to.be.true; });

item.name: The slot is no longer offered

exec: pm.test("Only the second slot is left", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(s => s.code).filter(c => c.startsWith(pm.collectionVariables.get("slotPrefix")))).to.eql([pm.collectionVariables.get("slotCode2")]));

item.name: Admin sees the occupant on the map

exec: pm.test("Occupied by the Postman employee", () => { const s = pm.response.json().find(x => x.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("slotId")); pm.expect(s.occupied).to.be.true; pm.expect(s.occupantName).to.eql("Postman Employee"); });

item.name: An occupied slot cannot be closed
Employee B asks with the same vehicle number
Employee B asks with their own vehicle
A taken slot refuses employee B
Another employee cannot cancel B's request

exec: pm.test("Rejected with the reason", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("REJECTED"); pm.expect(r.decisionReason).to.eql("Lot is full"); });

item.name: Employee B asks again and cancels

exec: pm.test("Released by the admin", () => { const a = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.active).to.be.false; pm.expect(a.releasedBy).to.eql("parkadmin"); });
pm.test("Released one is hidden", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(a => a.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("allocationId"))).to.be.false);
pm.test("Listed as released", () => { const a = pm.response.json().find(x => x.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("allocationId")); pm.expect(a.active).to.be.false; });
